title: Proper motion is skipped when only one axis moves
summary: indigocat_precession.c:97: proper-motion wrapper applies motion only if BOTH pmra and pmdec are nonzero. A star with motion in one axis is treated as stationary in both before precession. Public API allows independent components and catalog accessor passes them directly. Next: Apply when either component is nonzero (or always); verify one-axis-only motions against apply_proper_motion plus precess.
